job_description:
Articulate is the leading SaaS provider of online training solutions for the new world of work. Our industry-leading software and services make it simple for enterprises and SMBs to develop, deliver, and analyze online training that’s engaging and effective.

As the Staff Designer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our platform’s future state. You’ll lead projects of significant scope and complexity and serve as a leader within the Product Design group, demonstrating what excellent execution, collaboration, and communication look like. You’ll join a collaborative team focused on a core product experience, owning design throughout the product development lifecycle. Day-to-day, you’ll be leveraging best practices in product design to empower the team and deliver business value, including Design Sprints, rapid prototyping, collaborating on research, defining design specifications, participating in design reviews, and designing effective, efficient, and beautiful solutions to challenging problems. Navigating ambiguity is a strong suit, and you deeply value collaboration using the three-legged stool product development model.

Overall Impact

- You focus on the highest impact, future-facing decisions and are trusted with the most critical initiatives. Your impact is not only about execution but also about influence and guidance. You drive our design and quality standards across the organization.

- Clearly communicate complex concepts to stakeholders representing strategic and user-focused viewpoints with confidence and ease

- Efficiently estimate work timelines, prioritize efforts across multiple verticals, and drive work forward without supervision

- Steer design decision-making to meet the needs of users while also aligning with our business goals, measuring solutions and outcomes against providing customer value

- Track record of creating improvements across major parts of their department bringing about positive changes to the business

- You are a true multiplier: you use your unique skills and experience to push the Design organization to new heights.

What you'll do:
• Design Thinking & Storytelling
• Lead exploration for solving design problems across our family of SaaS products
• Use an expert level understanding of our products and assets, the competitive landscape, and our users in product decision-making
• Participate in interviews with customers to gain new insights and synthesize research into findings for potential product improvements
• Meet with the design team regularly to discuss product design decisions and transform product insights into intuitive, user-friendly application features
• Manage competing priorities and act on decisions in the face of ambiguity
• Design Execution
• Craft efficient user flows, thoughtful wireframes, high-fidelity pixel-perfect designs, prototypes, and pattern documentation leveraging our design system
• Create detailed design specs with all manner of states considered, well-annotated, and ready for handoff to our product development team
• Validate creative ideas through rapid prototyping and user testing
• Identify and proactively tackle future issues before they grow into something even bigger
• Break down complex projects into simple systems that can be effectively designed and maintained by less experienced designers
• Collaboration
• Collaborate closely with engineering and product tripod members to strategically iterate on and ship new features regularly
• Lead internal conversations with product and engineering about our design direction and synthesize decisions and designs in order to advise teams on execution.
• Proactively think of ways to improve collaboration between stakeholders, design, and engineering.
• Have mastered the art of the stakeholder review; completely own the feedback and design support they require on your projects

HP Inc. is an iconic brand, rooted in technology, pioneering new markets, and supporting values that have mattered for over 80 years. job_description:
Why join Stryker?

We are proud to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces and a Best Workplace for Diversity by Fortune Magazine! Learn more about our award-winning organization by visiting stryker.com

As an Architect, AI Systems, you will lead the design, development, and implementation of internally built AI solutions leveraging Azure-based technologies, with a focus on Azure Vision, Azure Language, and Azure OpenAI Service. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, identify AI opportunities, and architect scalable and innovative solutions that drive business value. This role requires expertise in Azure AI services, software architecture, and strong leadership skills to guide and inspire the team towards successful AI initiatives.

Who we want:

Dedicated achievers. People who thrive in a fast-paced environment and will stop at nothing to ensure a project is complete and meets regulations and expectations.

Goal-oriented developers. Keeping the customer and requirements squarely in focus, people who deliver safe and robust solutions.

Motivated product launchers. People who bring strategic direction and drive for execution to ensure products are developed and launched with precision.

What you will do:
• Solution Architecture: Design end-to-end AI solutions leveraging Azure Vision, Azure Language, and Azure OpenAI Service, considering factors such as data ingestion, preprocessing, modeling, deployment, and monitoring.
• Technical Leadership: Provide guidance and leadership to AI development teams, driving best practices, architectural standards, and ensuring alignment with Azure AI capabilities and industry trends.
• Requirement Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, understand use cases, and define AI solution objectives, ensuring alignment with business goals and priorities.
• Azure AI Implementation: Lead the implementation of AI solutions on Azure, including data integration, model development, integration with Azure services (e.g., Azure Cognitive Services, Azure Machine Learning), and deployment to Azure cloud environments.
• Custom Model Development: Develop custom machine learning models and algorithms using Azure Machine Learning, Azure Databricks, or other Azure-based tools, tailored to specific business needs and use cases.
• Integration and Orchestration: Integrate AI solutions with existing systems, applications, and data pipelines, leveraging Azure services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, and Azure Logic Apps for orchestration and automation.
• Performance Optimization: Optimize AI models and algorithms for performance, scalability, and efficiency, utilizing techniques such as distributed computing, parallel processing, and model tuning on Azure infrastructure.
• Security and Compliance: Ensure the security and compliance of AI solutions, adhering to Azure security best practices, data privacy regulations, and industry standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA).
• Monitoring and Maintenance: Implement monitoring and logging mechanisms to track the performance, reliability, and usage of AI solutions, and proactively identify and address issues to ensure uptime and availability.
• Documentation and Training: Create technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and best practice guidelines for AI development on Azure, and provide training and support to internal teams on Azure AI technologies and tools.

What you need:
• Bachelor's in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, Business, or equivalent field of study required.
• Master's degree in MIS, MBA or related disciplines preferred.
• 8+ years of experience in software engineering is required.
• 4+ years data engineering, or AI architecture roles, with a focus on building AI solutions on Azure preferred.
• Expertise in Azure AI services, including Azure Cognitive Services (Vision, Language, Speech), Azure Machine Learning, and Azure OpenAI Service preferred.
• Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, R, or C#, and proficiency in Azure cloud technologies (e.g., Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake, Azure Kubernetes Service) preferred.
• Experience in designing and implementing machine learning models, natural language processing (NLP), computer vision applications, and other AI technologies preferred.
• Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code (IaC) tools for automated deployment and management of Azure resources preferred.
• Azure certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert are a plus.
• Certifications in AI-related disciplines is preferred (e.g., AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate).

About Stryker

• 12 paid holidays annually
• Health benefits include: Medical and prescription drug insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, critical illness insurance, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, personalized healthcare support, wellbeing program and tobacco cessation program.
• Financial benefits include Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), 401(k) plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), basic life and AD&D insurance, and short-term disability insurance.

The supply chain data team sets the multi-functional data strategy and drives robust and scalable programs that will further accelerate the adoption of artificial intelligence.

The Director of Supply Chain Data and AI Strategy will lead a team of data scientists, analysts, program managers and data engineers that work multi-functionally across supply chain operations and enterprise IT. This leader will also foster industry and academic relationships, continually seeking to build a pipeline of new talent and solutions that utilize the latest technologies.

The Director of Supply Chain Data and AI Strategy is both a visionary and practical leader that will rely on their expertise in supply chain operations, business architecture, data, and advanced analytics to ensure the organization's data strategy is aligned to achievable business outcomes. The data strategy leader and team will lead data governance, AI/ML use case prioritization and multi-functional resource allocation. Additionally, this leader will advise the solution design, model development, and implementation of methods, processes, and systems to extract insights and intelligence from large, complex data sets.

• Leads the supply chain data strategy and advanced analytics center of excellence.

About Replit

Replit is where the world’s most productive developers write, share, and deploy code. Get started writing an application quickly without spending a second on environments or setup. Remix templates from the world’s top companies. Deploy in one click. Go from idea to software, fast.

About the role:

As an AI Data Engineer at Replit, your core mission is to empower and amplify AI capabilities through the seamless management and transformation of data at scale. You will collaborate closely with our platform and workspace teams to architect and build data pipelines and transformations, enabling us to create training datasets for our novel AI models. Your work will not only require processing data at scale, but also focusing (almost obsessively) on data quality.

If you are excited about the data pipeline we built for Replit Code Repair (Blog Post), this is the job for you! We are already working on new AI projects leveraging our unique data at Replit, and your role will help speed them up substantially.

You will…:
• Develop data pipelines to efficiently collect and process platform and workspace data, seamlessly transferring it to cloud storage and data warehouses.
• Create ETL jobs to wrangle, clean, filter, deduplicate, etc. training datasets for AI models.
• Quickly iterate over several data pipelines, driven by the insights gained by ablation studies.

Required skills and experience:
• Possess a minimum of 5 years of industry experience in a Data Engineering role, demonstrating a strong foundation in data manipulation and transformation.
• Proficiency in building data pipelines and workflows using Spark/Databricks and other ETL tools, with an emphasis on scalability and performance optimization.
• A keen interest in understanding the science (and art) of creating training datasets.
• Self-driven and comfortable working autonomously, capable of taking ownership of complex AI data engineering projects.

Bonus Points:
• Interest in the Developer Tools space

Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

     Flexible Work Hours

   Competitive Salary & Equity

   Home Office Set-Up Stipend

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

   Short Term and Long Term Disability

   Monthly Expenses Stipend

   Parental and Baby Bonding Leave

   Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

   Annual company/team offsites (4/year)

Want to Learn More?
• Replit Product
• Getting started with Replit
• Repl from Repo
• Replit Multiplayer
• Interviewing + Culture
• My First Software Engineering Job Interview
• Life at Replit
• Operating Principles
• Reasons not to work at Replit

To achieve our mission of making programming more accessible around the world, we need our team to be representative of the world. We welcome your unique perspective and experiences in shaping this product. We encourage people from all kinds of backgrounds to apply, including and especially candidates from underrepresented and non-traditional backgrounds.

The overall market range of base compensation for roles in this area of Replit is typically $150,000 - $190,000. Compensation offered will be determined by additional factors such as location and experience.

This is a full-time hybrid role with an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
